shared_elements: upright monolithic stone block carved as an anthropomorphic figure
frontal face with paired eyes rendered symmetrically about a vertical axis
justification: Both are frontal, vertically oriented stone monoliths whose upper portion carries a symmetrical face with paired eyes set beneath a heavy brow or headdress mass, and both are shown lit on a museum plinth. The rendering differs sharply: A is a heavily eroded, deeply modelled head alone with no surviving ornament, while B retains a full body covered with crisp shallow relief — bands, discs and geometric motifs — that has no counterpart in A.
